entries.text: Tests pin the `apply_rewrite` behavior of the ClickHouse, StarRocks and TPC-DS runner engine rewrites (`lowercase_identifiers`, `decimal_zero_literals`, `add_query_settings`, `correlated_exists_to_in`, `add_derived_table_aliases`, `qualify_order_by_columns`), and the golden-corpus engines area records two more safe-division inputs from the ClickHouse transformer tests.
